summaries.en: Yemen's pro-Iranian Houthi rebels officially joined the war by launching missile attacks on Israel, escalating the US-Israel-Iran conflict into an economic war that threatens global supply chains, including the potential blockade of the Red Sea.
summaries.zh: 亲伊朗的也门胡塞武装通过向以色列发射导弹正式参战，将美国、以色列与伊朗之间的冲突升级为一场经济战争，威胁到全球供应链，包括红海可能面临的封锁。
